dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hello, I'm interested in purchasing a new book. I have a budget of $30 to $60 and I'm looking for science fiction books with a sense of humor. I want books that have at least a 1 out of 5 star average rating. Can you please recommend some options that fit my criteria?
dialogue.agent:
Unfortunately, I could not find any science fiction books with humor that fit your price range and rating criteria. The closest matching book I found was "Uncle Buzzy's Big Fat Book O' Bee Cartoons", which is a collection of humorous bee-themed cartoons, but it is not a science fiction book. The price is $29.95, which is slightly below your $30-$60 budget, and it has a 4.0 out of 5 star average rating based on 1 review.

Given that I could not find any books that perfectly match all of your preferences, would you like me to search for books in a different genre or with different criteria? I'm happy to keep looking to try to find something that fits your needs.

products.title: Uncle Buzzy's Big Fat Book O' Bee Cartoons
products.description:
Review The ever popular cartoons you are familiar with in 'Bee Culture Magazine'. A must read!! Ten years of apiculture humor is gathered together here in one volume for your entertainment. A good form of laughter at the end of your Beekeeping day. --B&B Honey Farm About the Author Lela never meant to become a beekeeper, but 15 years ago she and her boyfriend were at a farm store that sold beekeeping supplies. A sudden impulse, and Lela and friend were beekeepers.
She found that beekeeping lent itself well to humorous satire, as do most painful or dangerous hobbies. But when she met and for-ever-nameless beekeeping friend at the Sonoma County Beekeeper s meeting that both humor and satire really clicked. They started with little pieces in their association newsletter, and moved on to bigger and better things, including Bee Culture magazine, and Editor s Flottum s almost as quirky ideas for cartoons and covers.
But Lela brings to both Bee Culture, and the whole world of beekeeping, a life time of experience and skills.
She majored in Commercial & Fine Art at Foothill College in California, and after one more watercolor class at San Jose State University began her career as a freelance artist. Her earlier and better-known works include a set of four portfolios with dragon and unicorn themes published by Schanes & Schanes. Not long after that she began working in the comic book industry, primarily on two bimonthly black & white titles for Eclipse Comics. 'The Dreamery', for which she did a cartoon rendition of 'Alice Through the Looking Glass', and 'Fusion', a tongue-in-cheek science fiction fantasy (splitting the art chores with artist Steve Gallacci.) A humorous spin-off of one of the back-up stories in 'Fusion' was The Weasel Patrol', a collaboration with Ken Macklin. It gained the attention of both Nickelodeon and the Cartoon Network, both of which seriously considered releasing it as a television cartoon series. She also did the layouts and finished pencils for a three-part graphic novel rendition of Anne McCaffrey's 'Dragonflight'.
Like many other artists left high and dry by the collapse of the comic book market in the mid 1990's, Lela eventually landed in the then fledgling computer games industry. After a crash course in computer animation she worked at LucasArts doing cartoon character animation for their critically acclaimed PC game 'Maniac Mansion, Day of the Tentacle', and 'Sam & Max Hit the Road'. I later freelanced for other computer game companies as well.
She s primarily a freelance commercial conceptual artist now, working on projects that involve cartooning, character or toy designs, logo design and book or magazine illustration. She often works on collaborate projects, and some past clients include Hasbro, Mattel, Electronic Arts, Totally Games, Big Ape Productions, Leapfrog, Yahoo!, XCOR, and Playdom. She still occasionally displays and sells her fine art and prints at sci-fi & fantasy convention art shows around the country.
Current Location and New Gallery
Most recently she and her husband have started Skylandgallery.com, an online wildlife art gallery.
Now living in the Santa Cruz mountains in Northern California with husband Frank Cirocco, she works primarily for his commercial art business 'Lightsource Studios', which he owns and manages with partner Gary Winnick. We suspect, however, that there s a bee or two still loose somewhere nearby.

This book is priced at $30.24, which is within your $30-$60 budget, and it has an average rating of 4.6 out of 5 stars based on 1 review.

Let me know if you would like me to search for any other science fiction options that meet your price and rating preferences. I'm happy to keep looking to try to find the best fit.

products.title: Glassford Girl: Complete Series (Parts 1 through 4) (Emily Heart Time Jumper Series)
products.description: From the Author When I began this series, I initially wanted to create a lovable teenage homeless girl who was struggling to survive life on the streets. What I ended up with was something completely different. Emily Heart came alive on the pages and touched my heart, leading me down a path of self-discovery right along with her. She's not just a 15-year-old girl who's burdened with an uncontrollable time jumping condition. She's a deeply caring, powerfully strong young lady with an unwavering will to survive. She has rules that she lives by, but finds that sometimes rules must be broken, even if it means that she might become too emotional and simply blink out of existence. Finding love is dangerous for everyone, but for Emily Heart it can mean the end of all that she is.Life on this planet isn't fun or fair for most of us, but for Emily Heart, life is all she wants. Fair or unfair, just making it through another day is reward enough. About the Author Jay J. Falconer is a award-winning, Amazon #1 Bestselling Author in Action & Adventure, Military Sci-Fi, Post-Apocalyptic, Young Adult, and Men's Adventure fiction. He lives in the high mountains of northern Arizona where the brisk, clean air and stunning views inspire his day. When he's not busy working on his next novel, he's out training, shooting, hunting, or preparing for whatever comes next.You can find more information about this Top-5 Science Fiction author and his books at JayFalconer.com, or on twitter at: @JayJFalconer, or on Facebook at: facebook.com/NarrowsOfTime/2016 Gold Medalist: Best Dystopia Book, Readers' Favorite International Book Awards2017 Gold Medalist: Best Young Adult Action Book, Readers' Favorite International Book AwardsAmazon Kindle Scout Winning Author

result.title: Glassford Girl: Complete Series (Parts 1 through 4) (Emily Heart Time Jumper Series)
result.features: Powers She Never Wanted. Powers She Can’t Control… Being an orphan is never easy. For teenagers like Emily Heart, it’s nearly impossible when you’re living on the streets. Yet, none of this is her fault. Someone kidnapped her and genetically altered her DNA. Now every day is a struggle. Everyone wants a piece of her. All Emily wants is her old life back. A life filled with family, friends, and a future she can count on. But staying alive won’t be easy, not with powers she can’t control. Even the slightest emotion can send her rocketing forward through time, never knowing how far she’ll travel or where she will land.However, there is one hope: beat reporter Jim Miller. He’s been tracking the never-aging 15-year-old across decades. When he finally catches up to her, the former Marine offers Emily protection from the gangs and the police in exchange for the scoop of a lifetime. For Emily, trust is never easy. But deep down she knows Miller is her one shot at finding the wicked minds responsible for her torment and making them pay for what they’ve done. Glassford Girl is an exhilarating series of paranormal time travel thrillers. If you like superhuman heroines, fierce fight scenes, and sci-fi mysteries, then you’ll love this award-winning action adventure from USA Today Bestselling Author Jay J. Falconer. Buy Glassford Girl to jump into a fast-paced, futuristic showdown today! Rated R for language, violence, and sexual situations.
